name: event-applicators-passthrough
description: The DnD event applicators (onDragStart/onDragOver/onDrop/onSort/onPin/onDragEnd) are ordinary event applicators: the __dnd interception does NOT swallow them, so they reach the create patch through the generic path as onX.0 action refs, with reserved named arguments (dwell on onDragOver) as sibling onX.<name> props. Renderers own dispatch and strip dwell from the payload; the engine never lowers them into a __dnd.* channel
